title: cenia hispida
intro: Cenia hispida, commonly known as the Velvet Bean or Cowhage, is a tropical plant native to the Americas and Africa, characterized by its velvety leaves and stems. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and alleviate menopausal symptoms due to its health benefits. Therapeutically, Cenia hispida is believed to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, making it a potential remedy for pain management and muscle relaxation. The plant's bioactive constituents include isoflavones, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
